environments.description: Per-environment configuration. Required for semver-per-env and calver-per-env strategies.

forges.description: Code-hosting platforms heraut talks to. Usually not needed: heraut finds the forge from the CI job or the git origin. Add one for a self-hosted instance, a custom token variable, or to publish to several forges.

Commits.description: How commit messages are read: the allowed types and scopes, ticket links, extra message rules, and where pull request data for the changelog comes from. Used by heraut commit verify and by the changelog alike.

types_heading_level.description: Heading depth (number of '#') of the type sections, such as ### 🚀 Features, in the changelog and release notes. Default 3.

types.description: Conventional-commit type rules, merged over the built-in defaults by name. The effective set is both the 'heraut commit verify' allow-list and the changelog section taxonomy.

scopes.description: Allowed scopes. Offered by 'heraut commit create'; enforced by 'heraut commit verify' only when scopes_restricted is true.

scopes_restricted.description: When true, 'heraut commit verify' rejects scopes outside the scopes list. Defaults to false.

tickets.description: Issue-tracker links. Each entry's regex is matched in commit messages and rendered as a link in the changelog and release notes.

name.description: Optional, unique name a commits.rules entry's tickets list uses to point at this entry, e.g. jira.

pattern.description: Regex matching ticket IDs, e.g. [A-Z]+-[0-9]+. The first capture group (or full match) becomes {ticket}.

rules.description: Extra checks on commit messages, run by heraut commit verify and commit check: a regex a message must or must not match, a required ticket reference, or a refusal, optionally limited to some types, scopes or breaking commits.

enrichment_forge.description: The forges[].name to read pull request or merge request data from (links, authors, new contributors) for every target's notes. Required with two or more forges. Example: github.

enrichment_policy.description: Whether to fetch pull request data: optional (the default) fetches it and warns when it can't, required fails the run instead, disabled never fetches. --offline forces disabled for one run.

TypeRule.description: One conventional-commit type rule, merged over the built-in defaults by name.

name.description: The conventional-commit type word (e.g. feat, fix).

order.description: Display sort position for the changelog section. Omit for unordered (sorts after ordered types).

render.description: Section heading label (e.g. "🚀 Features"). Omit to route the type into the catch-all "💼 Other" group (like the default build type).

remove.description: Drop this default type from the effective set (removes it from the 'heraut commit verify' allow-list).

description.description: One-line hint shown beside the type in the 'heraut commit create' wizard picker.

ScopeRule.description: One allowed commit scope. 'description' is shown in the commit wizard picker; 'remove' drops a built-in default scope.

remove.description: Drop this scope from the effective set — used to remove a built-in default (deps, deps-dev, release).

description.description: One-line hint shown beside the scope in the 'heraut commit create' wizard picker.

CommitRule.description: One extra check on commit messages. Set exactly one of deny (a regex that must not match), require (one that must), require_ticket or refuse; types, scopes and is_breaking pick the commits it checks. message is what the author sees when the check fails.

name.description: Rule name, shown in violation messages. Must be unique within commits.rules.

deny.description: Regex that must NOT match target.

tickets.description: With require_ticket: only the commits.tickets entries with these names count. Omitted or empty: any entry.

require_ticket.description: Shorthand: target must match one of the already-configured commits.tickets[].pattern entries, instead of duplicating a ticket regex in require. Requires a non-empty commits.tickets.

refuse.description: Refuses every commit the rule's filters (types, scopes, except_types, except_scopes, is_breaking) select. Needs at least one filter; target is not allowed with it.

except_types.description: Filter: the rule checks commits of every type but these. Not allowed with types.

except_scopes.description: Filter: the rule checks commits of every scope but these, commits without a scope included. Not allowed with scopes.

is_breaking.description: Filter: when true, the rule only checks breaking commits (a '!' before the header's colon, or a BREAKING CHANGE / BREAKING-CHANGE footer).

target.description: Part of the message matched against: the raw first line (header), the parsed body, the joined footer trailers (footer), or the full raw text (message, the default). Not allowed with refuse.

message.description: Shown when the rule is violated. Required for deny/require; optional for require_ticket and refuse (get a synthesized default naming the rule).

types.description: Optionally scope the rule to commits of these conventional-commit types. Omitting both types and scopes applies the rule to every commit.

scopes.description: Optionally scope the rule to commits with these scopes. Omitting both types and scopes applies the rule to every commit.

Hooks.description: Shell commands run at fixed points of a release, e.g. a build once the version is known. run can use {{ .Version }}, {{ .Tag }}, {{ .PreviousTag }}, {{ .Env }}, and {{ .Platform }} in pre_release and post_release.

post_bump.description: Runs immediately after the next version is resolved.

pre_tag.description: Runs before the local git tag is created.

post_tag.description: Runs after the tag is pushed to origin.

pre_release.description: Runs before publishing to a platform, once per platform.

post_release.description: Runs after publishing to a platform, once per platform.

HookStep.description: One hook command: run, the shell command, and for post_bump and pre_changelog only, stage, the files it changes that go into the release commit.

stage.description: Paths to stage after run completes. Only valid under post_bump/pre_changelog — a config validation error at any other hook point.

Rendering.description: Shapes the changelog and release notes: template snippets that replace the built-in blocks, and filters that drop commits. Set at the top level, per document (changelog, release.notes) or per environment; the closest level wins, key by key.

excludes.description: Filters that drop matched commits from the rendered changelog/release-notes.

templates.description: Go text/template snippets that replace built-in blocks by name, e.g. release.group for the type headings. Unset blocks keep their default. Merged from the top level, then per document, then per environment.

title.description: Document-level title, fired once per document (not once per release). Executes against .Heraut's own fields directly (.Version .URL .GeneratedAt), not the full release data — write {{ .Version }}, not {{ .Heraut.Version }}. Changelog default: '# Changelog'. Release-notes default: empty.

subtitle.description: Document-level subtitle rendered under title, fired once per document. Same .Heraut-only context as title. Empty by default, in the changelog and the release notes.

footer.description: Document-level footer, fired once per document (not once per release) — the trailing counterpart to title/subtitle. Same .Heraut-only context as title: write {{ .Version }}, not {{ .Heraut.Version }}. Default: '_Generated by [heraut](url) version at HH:MM on YYYY-MM-DD._'.

changelog.description: Root changelog-section template composing release.section, release.group, and commit.message blocks.

release_notes.description: Root release-notes template composing release.section, release.group, commit.message, release.contributors, and release.stats blocks.

release.description: Blocks used once per release in the document: its version heading, the type group headings, the new contributors and statistics blocks, and a footer after each release.

section.description: One release's version heading, fired once per rendered release. Changelog default: '## [version](compare-url) - date'. Release-notes default: empty.

contributors.description: The 'New Contributors ❤️' block wrapping the contributor entries (release notes).

stats.description: The Commit Statistics block (commit/issue counts, timespan) in release notes.

footer.description: Trailing content appended after each rendered release's body. Fires once per release, not once per document — use the top-level footer instead for document-level content. Empty by default.

commit.description: Blocks used once per commit: the commit line, its ticket links and the new-contributor entries, plus trailers, which sets how footer lines such as Co-authored-by render.

message.description: One commit line: description, scope, breaking marker, hash link, 'by @author', PR/MR reference, ticket links.

ticket.description: One ticket link within a commit line (called once per match from the commit.message block). Default: '([TICKET](url))'.

contributor.description: One entry in the New Contributors block for a first-time contributor.

trailers.description: How commit footer trailers render, by token (e.g. Co-authored-by): a template for the line, or hide to drop it. Merged by token from the top level, then per document, then per environment.

Exclude.description: Drops matched commits from rendered output. Set exactly one of type or regex.

type.description: Match commits of this conventional-commit type.

regex.description: Match commits whose subject matches this regex (e.g. "^chore\\(deps").

FooterRule.description: How one commit footer trailer renders, matched by its token regardless of case (e.g. Co-authored-by, Refs). Set either renderer or hide.

token.description: The trailer token to match, e.g. "Co-authored-by". Case doesn't matter.

renderer.description: Go text/template snippet executed with {Token, Value} as its data context, replacing the built-in "Token: Value" line for matching footers.

hide.description: Drops matching footers from rendered output entirely.

BumpConfig.description: SemVer auto-bump resolution mode and per-commit bump-level overrides.

mode.description: "auto" infers from conventional commits. "manual" requires --set-version. Defaults to "auto" when omitted.

overrides.description: Bump-level rules evaluated in order; the first match wins over the built-in defaults (breaking commits -> major, feat -> minor, any other conventional commit -> patch).

stay_at_v0.description: While the current major version is 0, hold a major bump back to minor (with a warning) instead of releasing 1.0.0. Lift it for one run with --allow-major. Defaults to false.

confirm_major.description: Refuse an automatic major bump, at any version, until the run is repeated with --allow-major, so a major release is always deliberate. version next still prints it, with a warning. Ignored with --set-version or mode: manual. Default false.

BumpRule.description: Assigns a bump level to commits matching type, regex, and/or breaking (all specified conditions must hold; at least one must be set). type and regex are mutually exclusive, like Exclude.

type.description: Match commits of this conventional-commit type.

regex.description: Match commits whose subject matches this regex.

breaking.description: Further scope the match to commits with (true) or without (false) the breaking-change flag/footer.

bump.description: Bump level to assign to matching commits. "none" excludes them from the release's bump entirely.

Versioning.description: How versions are computed and written as tags: the strategy (SemVer or CalVer, optionally one line per environment), the tag prefix or format, and how commits bump the version. Example: strategy: semver with tag_prefix: "v" gives tags like v1.4.0.

strategy.description: How versions are computed: semver from commit messages (v1.4.0), calver from the date (2026.11.0), or semver-per-env / calver-per-env for one version line per environment (dev, staging, prod).

tag_prefix.description: Prepended to every version tag. Defaults to "v" for semver and semver-per-env, "" for calver and calver-per-env. Set "" for bare version tags (1.2.3). Only tags with this prefix count as releases.

initial_version.description: Version used when no tags exist yet. SemVer strategies only.

bump.description: SemVer auto-bump resolution: mode and, for auto mode, per-commit bump-level overrides. SemVer strategies only.

format.description: CalVer format string (e.g. "YYYY.MM.PATCH"). Required for calver strategies.

sprint.description: Current sprint counter. Required when format contains SPRINT. Advance with heraut version sprint bump.

tag_format.description: Common tag format template for per-env strategies (e.g. "{env}/{version}"). {build} (CI build ID) must directly follow "+", e.g. "{env}/{version}+{build}" — SemVer build metadata.

tag_type.description: Git tag type. "annotated" (default) creates tags with a tagger, timestamp, and message. "lightweight" creates bare ref tags.

commit_message.description: Commit message template for the changelog commit, and (when tag_type is "annotated") the tag's own annotation message. "${version}" is substituted with the resolved version. Defaults to "chore(release): ${version}".

branches.description: Branches heraut may release from (semver only). An exact name is a release branch (main). A range, or a glob whose matched name ends in N.x or N.N.x, makes a maintenance branch limited to that line (release/1.x).

BranchRule.description: One branch heraut may release from: a release branch such as main, or a maintenance branch limited to a version range, such as release/1.x.

name.description: Exact branch name, or a glob in path.Match syntax ("*" does not cross "/").

range.description: Version range this branch may release: N.x (patch and minor bumps) or N.N.x (patch bumps only), e.g. 1.x or 1.3.x. Omit on a glob name to derive it from the matched branch name.

ContentDriver.description: A generated document: the changelog file (changelog:) or the notes published with each release (release.notes:). Sets where the changelog is written, which tags it covers, and its template and rendering overrides.

output.description: Where the changelog is written, e.g. CHANGELOG.md, inside the repository: a path or symlink leading out is refused. Only under changelog:, since release notes are never written to a file. Tokens start a new file per period: CHANGELOG_{YYYY}.md (CalVer) or CHANGELOG_{MAJOR}.md (SemVer).

tag_pattern.description: Regex selecting this scope's release tags, applied in-process (Go regex). E.g. "^v[0-9]" for bare semver or "^prod/" for a per-env prefix.

template.description: Path to a full Go text/template file layered over the built-in blocks. It can redefine the whole document or single blocks, and wins over rendering.templates for what it defines.

rendering.description: Rendering overrides for this document only (template snippets, excludes), merged over the top-level rendering block.

Notes.description: Configuration of 'heraut notes': the template layered over the built-in notes blocks (no release heading; commit lines without hash, author or PR reference).

template.description: Path to a full template file (Go text/template) parsed on top of the built-in blocks; it wins over inline rendering.templates for whatever it defines. 'heraut notes --template' replaces it for one run.

rendering.description: Template snippets and excludes for the notes, deep-merged over the global rendering block.

Release.description: Publishing: create a release with its notes on each target forge. Present, even as release: {}, means heraut release publishes; omit it for a project that only tags. Holds the targets, the files to attach and the notes settings.

notes.description: How the release notes published with each release are rendered: their template and rendering overrides. They are never written to a file, so output is refused here.

assets.description: Files to attach to every target's release, as glob patterns (e.g. dist/*.tar.gz). Each must match a file in the repository once post_bump hooks have run, or the release stops before committing. A target's own assets replace this list.

allow_missing_assets.description: Let an asset pattern match nothing: it is skipped with a warning instead of stopping the release. Set it when a pre_tag, post_tag or pre_release hook builds the files. Default false.

targets.description: Where to publish, each entry naming a forges[].name. Omit it to publish to the one forge found from the CI job or the git origin.

Forge.description: One code-hosting platform: its type, the project or repository, and how to reach it (base_url, api_url, token_env). What to publish goes in release.targets.

name.description: Unique identifier for this forge entry, referenced by release.targets[].forge and commits.enrichment_forge.

platform.description: The forge's type: github, gitlab or azure_devops. Azure DevOps supplies pull request data only; it has no releases to publish to.

project.description: GitLab project path (namespace[/subgroup]/repo). GitLab. For azure_devops, "organization/project".

repository.description: GitHub repository (owner/repo). GitHub. For azure_devops, the repository name.

base_url.description: Web base URL of the forge instance (e.g. https://gitlab.example.com for a self-hosted instance). Must be https (plain http is accepted only for loopback hosts). Defaults per type when unset.

api_url.description: API root, when it differs from the one derived from base_url. PR data and publishing both use it; links keep base_url. Must be https (plain http is accepted only for loopback hosts). Defaults per type when unset.

api_mode.description: How heraut calls the forge's API: rest (the default) or graphql.

token_env.description: Environment variable holding the API token. Defaults per type when unset.

Target.description: One place to publish the release: a forges[].name plus options for that target (draft, its own assets).

forge.description: References a forges[].name. Optional when exactly one forge is configured.

draft.description: Create the release as a draft, to publish by hand. GitHub only. Default false.

assets.description: Glob patterns of files to attach to this target's release only, replacing release.assets for it. The same rules apply: files in the repository, and each pattern must match unless allow_missing_assets is set.

EnvRelease.description: Per-environment release overrides. Absent fields inherit from root release.

notes.description: Release notes settings for this environment, merged over release.notes.

targets.description: Where to publish for this environment, replacing the top-level release.targets list entirely.

Environment.description: Per-environment configuration. Versioning fields drive version resolution; content fields override changelog/release.

bump.description: auto computes this environment's next version from its commits or the date; promote copies the latest version of the source environment (e.g. staging to prod).

tag_format.description: Per-environment tag format (e.g. "dev/{version}"). Must contain {version}. {build} (CI build ID) must directly follow "+", e.g. "{env}/{version}+{build}" — SemVer build metadata.

branch.description: Branch this environment is operated from. heraut refuses any --env command for this environment unless the current git branch matches (override with --force).

source.description: The environment a promote environment copies its version from, e.g. staging.

disable_changelog.description: Disable changelog generation for this environment.

disable_release.description: Disable the entire release: behavior (notes generation and publishing, together) for this environment.

changelog.description: Changelog settings for this environment, merged over the top-level changelog block.

release.description: Override release settings for this environment.

git.description: Override git.push_options for this environment, list by list.

Git.description: Options for the git commands heraut runs itself: the --push-option values of its two pushes.

PushOptions.description: --push-option values for heraut's pushes, e.g. commit: ["ci.skip"] to skip the release commit's GitLab pipeline. Under an environment, a missing list keeps the top-level one and [] clears it.

commit.description: Passed to the changelog commit push (git push origin HEAD), in order, e.g. ["ci.skip"] to skip that commit's GitLab pipeline.

tag.description: Passed to the tag push (git push origin <tag>), in order. Keep ci.skip out of it unless the tag pipeline should not run.
